svg.title: System Defence Craft - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 69-70, PDF 70-71. Full single-deck external armour envelope retains narrow chamfered forward bridge, long parallel central body, wider aft side shoulders and exposed twin drive stern. Illustration corroborates flattened broad aft blocks. Internal countermeasure-room walls and detached weapon symbols excluded.
